item.title: Version 1.0.27
item.description:
fix: separate flip errors from generic API errors

The "FLIP FAILED · TAP TO RETRY" banner used to surface ANY background
API error, including the auto-iPhone-app-list-sync that fires on app
launch.  If that 12-second sync timed out, you'd see a flip-failed
banner without ever attempting a flip.

Now flip-attempt errors and background-sync errors are tracked
separately.  The banner only shows when a real flip / unflip / emergency
unflip actually fails.

Includes 1.0.26's emergency-unflip widening (any committed time-bound
session, not just Focus) and the corrected "1 per month" cooldown copy.
